title: Folding Torus Fractal
subtitle: Homage to Yohei Nishitsuji (@YoheiNishitsuji)
description: Volumetric raymarched recursive folding fractal (#つぶやきGLSL) homage to Yohei Nishitsuji (@YoheiNishitsuji). Features a 7-iteration 3D axis-angle rotation with kaleidoscopic absolute folding and exponential glow accumulation.
